name: E3a_pcm_nonlinearity
title: PCM read nonlinearity at the two drift-compensation nodes: input remap versus divider supply (linear rule and replica rule), lower-bound branch, sky130 PDK mismatch

pcm_model.iv: I(V) = A s(V; V0), s = V0 sinh(V/V0) (linear limit for V0 = inf); a state is identified by its chord conductance at the programming voltage D: G = I(D)/D
pcm_model.state_dependence: V0(G) = V0_ref (G / G_ref)^beta, G_ref = 12.5 uS (theta = 0.5); the V0 of a cell programmed to level theta is V0(G(theta))
pcm_model.drift: uniform factor on the whole characteristic: I(V, t) = a I(V, 0)

grid.note: V0_ref = inf is the linear PCM (one point, beta irrelevant); 1 + 7 x 3 = 22 grid points

nodes.dac_remap: map Ma(x) = B_nom(a G(x)) at V_SL,nom (PCM voltage at the switching point unchanged)
nodes.supply_lin: V_SL(t) = V_sw,nom + D / a (the E2 rule, exact only for a linear PCM), map M0
nodes.supply_rep: V_SL(t) = V_sw,nom + V*, a s(V*; V0(G_rep)) = s(D; V0(G_rep)), replica at G_rep = 12.5 uS (theta = 0.5), map M0

laws.dac_remap: dx = (G/dG) [eps(aI) - eps(I)] (E2 law; independent of the PCM nonlinearity)
laws.supply: dx = (G/dG) [(rho(delta) - 1) + rho0 (eps(rho0 I) - eps(I))], rho(delta) = a s(V_t - delta; V0) / s(D - delta; V0), rho0 = rho(0)
laws.rms: E[dx^2] = (G/dG)^2 { E_delta[(rho(delta) - 1 + rho0 dlambda delta)^2] + rho0^2 sum_p ds_p^2 }; predicted rms (LSB) = 15 sqrt(mean over theta)
laws.inputs_allowed: nominal and +-1 sigma single-device simulations only (same sensitivities as E2), no Monte Carlo

circuit.criterion: bound = V_DL at which V_X = V_sw; V_sw = gate voltage at which the pull-down conducts 100 nA * W/L with V_DS = 1.8 V
circuit.programming: threshold verify at V_SL,nom: the PCM current at its own voltage D - delta_k equals I_div,k(M0(theta)); no clipping

designs.note: E1 P1: supply better for a linear PCM

mismatch.rng: numpy.random.default_rng([base_seed, rng_stream]); z_div = standard_normal((n, 4)); then z_pd = standard_normal((n, 4)); columns (vth0, toxe, voff, nfactor); fresh draws (E1 stream 0, E2 stream 2)

drift.model: uniform factor a = (t/t0)^-nu, perfect tracking (a_hat = a)

metric: input-referred bound error 15 (x_eff - theta) in LSB, rms over all (instance, theta) pairs, theta_j = j/15; x_eff from the exact inverse of the nominal map: G(x_eff) D = I_0(b) for M0, G(x_eff) a D = I_0(b) for Ma (I_0 = nominal divider current at V_DS = V_sw,nom)

checks.C1: full-branch DC with the PCM as a nonlinear element (ngspice B-source I = A V0 sinh(V/V0)) equals the I-V inversion within 0.05 mV: nominal cell, G in {2.5, 12.5, 22.5} uS, (V0_ref, beta) in {(inf, 0), (0.3, 0), (0.3, +0.5)}, V_SL,nom and the 1-year V_SL of supply_lin and supply_rep, every design
checks.C2: zero mismatch: dac_remap and ideal errors <= 0.001 LSB; supply errors equal 15 (G/dG)(rho0 - 1) within 0.001 LSB, every design, grid point and time (pairs with a valid bound)
checks.C3: ideal node error <= 0.001 LSB on all valid pairs
checks.C4: Monte Carlo sigma of V_sw within max(0.15, 3/sqrt(2(n-1))) relative of the predicted sigma_delta
checks.C5: dac_remap: pairs without a valid bound <= 1 % for every design, grid point and time (stop rule); supply_lin and supply_rep may lose pairs at strong nonlinearity (reported; grid points with > 1 % invalid pairs are excluded from B2 and B3)
checks.C7: nominal divider curve identical in both phases
checks.stop_rule: any failed check stops the run before the decisions are evaluated

decisions.tolerance: a prediction passes if |pred - sim| <= max(0.15 sim, 0.02 LSB)
decisions.B1: input remap immune: full-branch DC simulation with the PCM as a nonlinear element (ngspice B-source), programmed by threshold verify at V_SL,nom and drifted by a (1 year), first 20 Monte Carlo instances (pdk), theta in {1, 5, 10, 14}/15: the errors for (V0_ref, beta) in {(0.3, 0), (0.3, +0.5), (0.15, -0.5)} equal those for the linear PCM within 0.001 LSB, every design (the Monte Carlo rms of dac_remap is independent of the grid point by the same argument and is reported)
decisions.B2: extended supply law: supply_lin and supply_rep, 1 year, all (design, grid point) with <= 1 % invalid pairs: at least 90 % pass
decisions.B3: ranking: 1 year, every (design, grid point) where the predicted gap between supply_rep and dac_remap is >= 20 % of the larger: the predicted better node equals the Monte Carlo better node
decisions.conclusion: the extended laws are validated if B1, B2 and B3 hold; the crossover nonlinearity (largest V0_ref at which supply_rep is no longer better than dac_remap) is then read from the validated predictions and checked against the Monte Carlo
decisions.secondary: 1 day and 30 days; supply_lin crossover; voltage stress (PCM voltage at the switching point and at the top input for the lowest level); per-theta systematic error

voltage_stress: nominal cell, linear PCM and (V0_ref, beta) = (0.3, 0): PCM voltage at the switching point for each node at 1 year, and the PCM voltage when the input is at the top of the input range (x = 1) and the cell holds the lowest level (G = 2.5 uS), from a full-branch DC simulation
